centralProperty: Value conservation across the in-place migration round trip: for each re-injected user, principal credited back into the staker (userInfo.amount) must equal principal parked at migrateOut (story-012 AC-1, par-preservation).

invariants.name: test_haircut_conservationBreaks_200bps
invariants.description: Fixed 200bps haircut strategy: asserts credited < parked per-user and aggregate, totalParked driven to 0 regardless, pool.totalStaked == credited sum. Confirms the conservation violation with concrete numbers.

invariants.name: testFuzz_haircut_conservationAlwaysBreaks
invariants.description: Fuzzed depositSlippageBps over 1..500 bps (256 runs): credited sum strictly < parked sum for every positive haircut; totalParked always reaches 0; pool tracks the credited (haircut) principal only.

invariants.name: test_par_conservationHolds_0bps
invariants.description: depositSlippageBps == 0 (par): credited == parked per-user, aggregate, and == original stake. Confirms the bug is specifically the haircut and the existing suite's green status is a par-mock artifact.

invariants.name: test_zeroCreditUser_revertsWholeSlice_thenClaimTimedOutRescues
invariants.description: A dust user whose credit rounds to 0 (100% slippage) makes depositFor revert ('StableStaker: nothing credited'), bubbling up to revert the ENTIRE migrateIn slice (state rolled back, all users still parked). claimTimedOut then returns that user's full parked principal.
invariants.expected: migrateIn slice reverts; principal recoverable via timeout hatch
